artifact_observations.reasoning: The front white bumper/fender area exhibits significant geometric distortion. It appears to melt into the ground and lacks clear definition between the tire well and the body panel. The geometry does not follow logical automotive design principles.
The driver's feet appear to merge slightly with the floorboard/step area, lacking distinct separation shadows and edge clarity.
The black pillars supporting the roof have inconsistent thickness and slight waviness, suggesting minor generation instability.
